title: Briana Piedra Delivers a new single titled "In My Head"
htmlContent:
American-based Portland artist Briana Piedra is a multi-talented singer and songwriter who has climbed the steepest steps to get to where she is today. Her creative output is nearly unparalleled, and with that activity, she continues to raise the bar, especially with her recent song "In My Head."

Briana Piedra's "In My Head" is a bubbly pop melody about an inward/outward battle between logic and emotions. She gives you everything you could ask from an artist and more as she creates a modern-day masterpiece that her fans will be able to enjoy for the time to come.
